name: What are the benefits of custom kitchen cabinets versus stock cabinets for storage?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of custom kitchen cabinets versus stock cabinets for storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets offer tailored solutions, precisely fitting your kitchen's unique dimensions and maximizing every inch of available space, especially beneficial in irregular layouts. They allow for personalized features like specific drawer depths, built-in organizers, and unique finishes. Stock cabinets are generally more affordable and quicker to install but offer limited sizes and fewer customization options, potentially leading to wasted space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets maximize space and offer personalized features for unique kitchen layouts, while stock cabinets are more affordable but have limited options.
